description:
List email messages synced from your firm's connected mailboxes, newest first, 25 per page:
    sender, subject, preview, received time, linked client, read flag and the AI classification
    (category, priority, sentiment, summary). Members without the whole-book role see only email
    linked to clients assigned to them, plus email not yet linked to a client. Filter by client_id,
    priority (comma-separated: CRITICAL, HIGH, NORMAL, LOW) or category (comma-separated: INQUIRY,
    INSTRUCTION, COMPLAINT, UPDATE, SOCIAL, SPAM).
name: get_email_messages
title: List client emails
